name: SignuDoc

var_descriptions.signudoc.DATABASE_URL: Postgres connection string, built from the bundled postgres service
var_descriptions.signudoc.APP_URL: Public HTTPS address for links, auth callbacks and emails; update it if you add a custom domain
var_descriptions.signudoc.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: Generated key that signs sessions and encrypts the sealing key; keep it stable
var_descriptions.signudoc.SETUP_TOKEN: Generated secret the first-run /setup page asks for, so nobody else can claim the install
var_descriptions.signudoc.RETENTION_JOB_SECRET: Generated secret that closes the daily cleanup route to everyone but the built-in scheduler

title: SignuDoc (Self-Hosted DocuSign Alternative)
short_desc: Self-hosted e-signature app to send, sign and seal PDFs
angle: Run your own DocuSign: upload a PDF, place signature fields, invite signers by link and get a sealed PDF with an audit trail and signing certificate, without per-envelope fees. Zero inputs on Railway: Postgres bundled, PDFs on a volume, setup page locked behind a generated token, daily retention cleanup scheduled inside the container. Note: another third-party 'signudoc' template exists (Ju Li, 2 deploys); this one builds the upstream source at a pinned commit and also locks setup and the retention route.
notes: Upstream has no image or Dockerfile (Vercel-first), so ghcr.io/onepush-dev/signudoc:0.5.2 is built from NYLLON-SOFTWARE/SignuDoc at commit 24ecc5d (code unmodified; Node 24; start script runs db migrations every boot, binds :: on 8080 and calls /api/internal/retention ~2 min after boot and every 24h). Railway healthchecks only pass on /api/auth/ok (all page routes redirect to /setup before setup). EMAIL_DRIVER left unset; RESEND_API_KEY / RESEND_FROM_EMAIL / SUPPORT_EMAIL are optional extras users can add for signing emails (without Resend no emails are delivered). First visit /setup needs SETUP_TOKEN (service variable) plus support address; breached passwords are rejected. Not affiliated with SignuDoc.
fresh_test: Built + FRESH-TEST PASSED Nov 20 ~11:00 AM IST: test-signudoc from VYzQLS (signudoc + postgres) deployed with no inputs and healthy; bad setup token 403; /setup with generated SETUP_TOKEN created the admin (201), second setup 409; sign-in OK; PDF uploaded into a draft envelope and downloaded byte-identical (594 bytes) from the /data volume; retention route 401 anon and 200 with RETENTION_JOB_SECRET; in-container scheduler logged 'retention job ok' ~2 min after boot; after redeploying postgres then signudoc, login still works and the PDF is still there (persistence OK).
